# Creator Examples

> A plain-text database of creator content examples (YouTube intros and more), kept by Riley Brown. Every page is unstyled HTML. Machine-readable JSON lives under /data/.

- Home: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/
- Intros index: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/intros/
- Data index: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/data/index.json
- Skill for agents: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/skill/SKILL.md

## Intros: Theo
- Creator page: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/intros/theo/
- JSON: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/data/theo.json
- Method: Top 10 of 270 uploads (Sept 2025 to Sept 2026) ranked by views divided by channel median views (104.5K). Intro = spoken opening up to the sentence that hands off to the sponsor read. Transcripts from OutlierKit via Composio; video list via Monid.

## Intros: Greg Isenberg
- Creator page: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/intros/greg-isenberg/
- JSON: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/data/greg-isenberg.json
- Method: Top 10 of 108 long-form uploads (Sept 2025 to Sept 2026) ranked by views divided by channel median views. Intro = everything before the conversation or teaching starts: the produced cold open plus the guest setup exchange, ending at the handoff line ("let's get into it", "Enjoy the episode"). Transcripts are YouTube captions.
- https://creator-examples.vercel.app/intros/greg-isenberg/01-how-ai-agents-claude-skills-work-clearly-explained/ : How AI agents & Claude skills work (Clearly Explained) (837,314 views)
